Issue 6.2 (2025)

We invite submissions for the second issue of 2025.

Deadline (for issue 6.2): July 15, 2025. Later submissions will be considered for a subsequent issue.

Research papers are welcome; the issue is unthemed.

Book reviews are to be submitted on a solicited basis only.
